title: SignalTerrain
lead: One calm place to open each day: a cyber awareness brief from verified public sources — what changed, why it matters, who may be affected, and defensive next steps. Not a news feed, not a SIEM, not offensive security.
mission: Defensive-minded professionals and serious amateurs who need trustworthy public-source cyber context without hype, fear, or attack tooling.
problems: Public cyber news is noisy and often hyped
People need sourced priorities and defensive guidance — not exploit kits or SIEM consoles
Sample demos must never be mistaken for live intelligence

capabilityGroups.title: Cyber Awareness (MSP)
capabilityGroups.description: Daily brief from verified public sources with trust labels, refresh time, and provider health. Educational and defensive only.

capabilityGroups.title: Labeled samples
capabilityGroups.description: Topics, graph, and summary demos stay explicitly labeled samples — never substituted for live intelligence.

capabilityGroups.title: Radio & spectrum (later)
capabilityGroups.description: RF literacy tools remain on the roadmap and are not part of the current cyber-brief Minimum Subscription Product.

principles: Four questions: what changed, why it matters, who is affected, what should happen next
Evidence and trust labels over fear or hype
Live means a fresh public-source artifact — stale data is labeled Stale, not Live
Educational cyber awareness only — not scanning, offense, SOC, IDS, or IPS
Never fabricate signals, incidents, or threat claims

modules.title: Cyber Live intelligence
modules.description: Verified public sources — daily brief with priority, trust, freshness, and provider health.

modules.title: Intelligence Summary (samples)
modules.description: Educational sample UIOs — labeled samples, not live intelligence.

modules.title: Topic foundation (samples)
modules.description: Shared topic model demos with confidence and unknowns.

privacyPhilosophy: Persona preferences stay in your browser. Precise locations are not required for the cyber brief. Samples are labeled samples — never presented as live intelligence.
futureDirection: Radio & spectrum literacy and deeper cyber topic coverage remain carefully bounded future phases — educational, never offensive.
